title: Row-refined skew stable Grothendieck expansion for connected skew shapes with same-column upward and downward extensions
author: Melody Chan; Nathan Pflueger
work: Combinatorial relations on skew Schur and skew stable Grothendieck polynomials
source_version: Algebraic Combinatorics 4 (2021), issue 1, pp.175--188, DOI10.5802/alco.144; official published native and PDF, acquired2026-10-04
difficulty_reason: Ordinary RSK insertion does not directly give the two-sweep skew set-valued bijection with simultaneous row flags above and below the connected shape. The authors prove that bijection and invert its recursive count through an acyclic-poset signed-chain cancellation lemma, including its required local claim and proof. Together these isolate the semistandard coefficients in the row-refined skew stable Grothendieck expansion; no supporting lemma is counted separately.
